source:
@@U00738@@
But the lords and ladies of
Court started itching,
The Queen and her Ladies-in-
Waiting were bitching;
But nobody dared give those
Fine fleas a smack.
Let them come biting us,
We'll give them a crack.

@@U00740@@
(Shouting.)

@@U00741@@
Let them come biting us,
We'll give them a crack.

@@U00743@@
Bravo! Bravo! Well done!

@@U00745@@
That should be the fate of every flea!

@@U00747@@
You get them between your finger and thumb
and nip them nicely!

@@U00749@@
Long live freedom!
Long live wine!

@@U00751@@
I'd gladly drink a glass to freedom
if your wines weren't quite so—awful.

@@U00753@@
Let’s hear no more of that!

@@U00755@@
If the host didn’t mind, I’d treat our worthy guests
with a marvelous something from our own fine cellar.
translation:
@@U00738@@
但贵族们和女士们
法庭开始发痒，
女王和她的女人们——
等待是痛苦的；
但没有人敢给那些
细跳蚤一口。
让他们过来咬我们，
我们会给他们一个机会。

@@U00740@@
（喊叫。）

@@U00741@@
让他们过来咬我们，
我们会给他们一个机会。

@@U00743@@
太棒了！太棒了！干得好！

@@U00745@@
这应该是每只跳蚤的命运！

@@U00747@@
你可以把它们放在手指和拇指之间
并好好地咬住它们！

@@U00749@@
自由万岁！
酒万岁！

@@U00751@@
我很乐意为自由干杯
如果你的酒不是那么糟糕。

@@U00753@@
我们不要再听到这些了！

@@U00755@@
如果主人不介意的话，我会招待我们尊贵的客人
以及来自我们自己精美地窖的奇妙物品。
